facebook.caption:
606 reviews. 4.0 stars. Suoi Tranh Waterfall keeps showing up on lists and people keep sleeping on it.

This is one of Phu Quoc's few inland escapes. Jungle trail, rushing water, no beach crowds. Just the sound of the falls and a lot of green.

If your Phu Quoc itinerary is all beaches and sunsets, add this. Your body will thank you.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
